visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. No mockup in this directory: the place-type class is the city/community type-card landing, not a Tetherow one-off.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker type-filtered city results. Those surfaces dump the visitor into a search grid. This page is a place-type node: leftover count and median that already back the type card, a living atlas of the parent city with the type stated in the claim, and a photographed list of that type. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: H1 is `{Type} in {Place}` (Condos in Redmond) and it is the page's only display-scale line: the Atlas opens directly under it wearing an eyebrow (V3Atlas headlineTone='eyebrow'), not a second Amboqia title. One section-0 sourced claim sentence sits under the H1 with its source line — the count, the lowest ask and the highest all come from ONE listing_tile_mv read, because leftover market truth and the MV disagree by 14% on Bend single-family (658 vs 768 measured 2026-09-09) and a count from one pipeline beside a band from the other describes two sets. The Atlas section is UNCONDITIONAL: PlaceTypeAtlasSection streams behind a Suspense boundary whose fallback and whose miss branch are both PlaceTypeAtlasStandin, so the differentiator is never simply absent. Rows and marks share one hovered key in both directions. Unknown type notFound(). Do not collide with app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug].

tasteReview.evaluator: Separate Agent subagent, one per class, spawned by the builder with the rubric table, the two shot paths and TASTE.md, told not to read page source; three independent scorings in the one call, median recorded. Four scoring rounds ran on this node (medians place-type 71/69/67/77, place-type-community 73/70/68/70); the recorded round is the last one, whose prompt carries no round history, matching the conditions of the 2026-09-08 table instrument.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, next dev on the lane's own branch

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's Bend map-search page: pin clutter, ad units and mixed typography over a generic basemap, against one quiet navy-on-cream instrument whose map encodes 90-day sale density instead of stacking pins, with the count and the price band stated in a sentence and traced to the MLS read that produced them.

defects.finding: Just listed / Went pending / Sold render as three plain sentences with identical dots and no encoding of stage, price or recency, two inches from a heatmap that solves the same problem with a real visual encoding.

The rail groups a gradient legend, a dot legend, a checkbox and a price scrubber with whitespace alone, and the type control is a bare checkbox rather than a control from the system's own set. Both belong to V3Atlas and change every caller, so they are named here rather than fixed in this node.

At 375 the rail and both next-actions sit below the map, so the phone's first screen is the title, the claim, the source line and the map with nothing to filter or tap. Moving the rail above the map was tried and scored WORSE on both classes (place-type 71 to 69, place-type-community 73 to 70) because it buried the map; the real answer is a compact control bar inside V3Atlas, for every caller.
Rail beside map is the most-copied shape in real estate; the brand reads from the palette and the type, not yet from the composition itself.
The evaluator read the zoom pair as possibly under the 44px floor from the still. Measured in the browser at 375 it is 44.0 by 44.0 on both buttons, from --v3-tap; no change made.

priorMark.note: structure pass, no rendered shots; the 2026-09-08 taste table scored this class 69 (64/69/73) on the same rubric and shot spec.

tasteReview.rebaselineReason: The committed mark carries no evaluatorModel, no rubricVersion and no shotsHash — it was a structure pass with no rendered shots — so it is not the same instrument and cannot be risen above.
